app.name: Agora
app.tagline: Ankara University student information system and learning environment

features.oneplace: Course registration, grades and learning in one place
features.anywhere: On the web and mobile, in Turkish and English

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.mfaRequired: Sign in with two-step verification to do this.
errors.notFound: The record you are looking for was not found.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

pageNotFound.title: Page not found
pageNotFound.description: The page you are looking for may have moved or never existed.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: An unexpected error occurred while loading the page.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your student or staff number and password.

messages.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
messages.passwordSet: Your password has been saved. You can sign in with your new password.
messages.accountActivated: Your account is active. Sign in with the password you have set.

errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. The account is temporarily locked, try again in {{time}}.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account is not active. Contact the registrar's office or IT services.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
errors.INVALID_MFA_TOKEN: Verification timed out. Please sign in again.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code can be used once.
mfa.useRecovery: I can't access my phone, use a recovery code
mfa.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your number or email address. If you have an account, we will send you a password reset link.
forgot.sentDescription: If the details match an account, a link will be sent within a few minutes. The link is valid for 30 minutes. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.

reset.invalidDescription: The link is invalid, already used or expired. Request a new one.
reset.resetDescription: Choose a new password for your account. You will be signed out on all devices.
reset.activationDescription: Welcome to Agora. Set a password to start using your account.

password.hint: At least 10 characters. Easy-to-guess passwords and passwords containing your name, number or email are not accepted. A sentence of several words is a good choice.

violations.TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 10 characters.
violations.TOO_LONG: The password can be at most 128 characters.
violations.TOO_COMMON: This password is too common and easy to guess.
violations.CONTAINS_PERSONAL_INFO: The password must not contain your name, number or email.
violations.SAME_AS_CURRENT: The new password must differ from your current one.

force.title: Change your password
force.description: Before you continue, you need to change the temporary password you were given.

change.title: Password
change.description: Changing your password signs you out on every other device.
change.success: Your password has been changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

mfaBanner.title: Two-step verification required
mfaBanner.description: Some of your permissions (e.g. administration) can only be used in sessions signed in with two-step verification.

roles.title: Your roles
roles.empty: No role has been assigned to your account yet.

upcoming.title: Academic modules
upcoming.description: Course registration, grades and transcripts, attendance and the learning environment will appear here in turn.

security.title: Security
security.description: Your password, two-step verification, sessions and account activity.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.about: When you sign in, a 6-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone is required in addition to your password. Even if your password is stolen, nobody can get into your account. You can use Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a similar app.
mfa.recoveryLow: You are running out of recovery codes. Generate new ones.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup.manual: If you can't scan the QR code, enter this key manually:
setup.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app and your current password.

codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.description: If you can't access your phone, you can sign in with these codes. Each code can be used once. They won't be shown again: save them somewhere safe now.
codes.confirm: I have saved the codes somewhere safe
codes.fileHeader: Agora recovery codes ({{username}}). Each code can be used once.

mfa.enabled: Two-step verification is on. Your other sessions were signed out.
mfa.regenerated: New recovery codes generated. The old ones no longer work.

disableDialog.title: Turn off two-step verification
disableDialog.description: Your account will be protected by your password only and permissions that require two-step verification will be unavailable. Enter your current password and a verification code.

regenerateDialog.title: Regenerate recovery codes
regenerateDialog.description: All old codes will stop working. Enter the code from your authenticator app.

errors.INVALID_MFA_CODE: Incorrect code. Enter the current code from the app.
errors.MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED: The setup has expired. Please start again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices where your account is signed in. End any session you don't recognise and change your password.
sessions.endOthersConfirm: All your sessions except this device will be signed out. Continue?
sessions.empty: You have no other open sessions.

events.title: Security history
events.description: Sign-ins and security activity on your account. If you see something you don't recognise, change your password.

types.MFA_CHALLENGE_STARTED: Password verified, waiting for second step

users.title: Users
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, number or email
users.name: Name

create.title: New user
create.description: The account is created awaiting activation. The user sets their own password through the link sent to their email.

errors.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: This number or email is already registered to another account.
errors.SELF_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: You can't do this on your own account.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE: An account that hasn't been activated can't be activated manually. Resend the activation email.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_PENDING: The account is not awaiting activation.
errors.MFA_NOT_ENABLED: Two-step verification is not on for this user.
errors.LAST_SYSTEM_ADMIN: The last system administrator's role can't be ended.
errors.ROLE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: This role is already assigned in this scope for an overlapping period.

statusDialog.title: Change account status
statusDialog.description: All sessions of a suspended or disabled account are ended immediately.

mfaDialog.title: Reset two-step verification
mfaDialog.description: For a user who lost both their phone and their recovery codes. Don't do this without verifying their identity in person: it is the easiest way to take over an account. All the user's sessions will be ended.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role assignments and history. Changes take effect immediately.

assignDialog.title: Assign role
assignDialog.description: The role is granted in the selected scope. An empty start means now, an empty end means no end date.

endDialog.title: End role assignment
endDialog.description: The {{role}} role ends immediately and the user loses its permissions.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Audit trail of write operations and security events.

calendar.title: Academic calendar
calendar.description: Action windows and key dates of the term.

windows.title: Action windows
windows.description: Course registration, approvals and grade entry are only possible while their window is open. A unit's own window replaces the university's.

events.title: Calendar
events.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" will be removed from the calendar. This is recorded in the audit log.

form.description: Events of the same type in the same scope cannot overlap.
form.titleHint: If empty, the type name is shown.
form.publishedHint: Draft events are visible to calendar managers only.

errors.EVENT_OVERLAP: An event of the same type already overlaps in this scope.
errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: The event changed while you were editing. Close and reopen the dialog.

catalog.title: Course catalog
catalog.description: All courses of the university: hours, credits, prerequisites and equivalences.
catalog.name: Course

relations.REPLACED_BY: This course was replaced by (new code):

detail.prerequisitesHint: At least one course from each box must be satisfied.
detail.noRequiredBy: This course is not a prerequisite of another course.
detail.equivalencesHint: Courses whose code changed count for each other under their old and new codes.
detail.groupsHint: Elective slots in curricula can be filled from these pools.

curriculum.title: Curricula
curriculum.description: Versioned curricula of programmes: which entry years follow which plan and the semester layout.
curriculum.chooseProgram: Choose a programme to see its curricula.

view.empty: This version has no courses yet.

edit.addDescription: Place a compulsory course or a slot to be filled from an elective pool into a semester.
edit.slotHint: Hours, credit and ECTS are totals of the slot's courses (e.g. 2 courses × 4 ECTS = 8).

form.newDescription: The version starts as a draft and is put into force after its rows are edited.
form.editDescription: The first entry year and ECTS total of a version in force cannot change.
form.toHint: Empty means open to new entrants.
form.toAfterFrom: Cannot be before the first entry year.

confirm.activate: Once "{{name}}" is in force its semester layout is frozen and students in its entry-year range are linked to it.
confirm.archive: "{{name}}" is archived if no student follows it any more.
confirm.delete: The draft "{{name}}" and its rows will be deleted.
confirm.remove: {{code}} will be removed from the curriculum.

errors.COURSE_ALREADY_IN_CURRICULUM: This course is already in the curriculum.

my.title: My curriculum
my.description: The curriculum you follow in your programme, based on your entry year.
my.noPrograms: You are not enrolled in a programme.
my.notAssigned: Your {{program}} enrolment is not linked to a curriculum version yet. Contact the registrar.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: The term's timetable: courses offered by a department, a classroom's occupancy or an instructor's classes.

choose.bolum: Choose a department to see its timetable.
choose.derslik: Choose a classroom to see its occupancy.
choose.hoca: Search for an instructor to see their timetable.

schedule.empty: No sessions in the timetable for this selection.

teaching.title: My teaching
teaching.description: Sections you teach this term and your weekly timetable.
teaching.empty: You do not teach a section this term.
